'''Synoda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Synoda joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement project]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to investigate [[Colu's syndrome]], a rare disease that afflicted only the descendants of the survivors of Taris' [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]]. Her own ancestors had fled Taris [[3956 BBY|three centuries]] ago, meaning that Dr. Synoda was likely afflicted by Colu's syndrome as well.<ref name="TOR" />

Synoda based her research in a small camp in the Republic Reconstruction Grounds, near [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]]. As that area was rife with [[rakghoul]]s, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and wild [[ferrazid hound]]s, Synoda employed a unit of Republic [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]].<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], she asked a traveling hero to help her with her research. Synoda asked them to recover the records of the Tarisians who lived before the bombardment from the ruins of [[Dynamet General Hospital]], which was overrun with rakghouls and infected sentients. The hero was able to recover the records, which she believed would greatly aid her research and help alleviate the suffering of the Tarisian descendants.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Synoda was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]]<ref name="TOR" />
released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> She appears on Taris, where she can give Republic characters the mission "Legacy of Death".<ref name="TOR" />
